landing.headline: Plan one journey for everyone travelling with you.
landing.intro: PAYANI helps groups find direct and connecting trains, split into valid bookings, and get reminded before departure.
landing.statusBody: PAYANI is being built in phases. Accounts work today. Journey search, group planning and reminders arrive next, using clearly labelled sandbox data.
landing.pillarsTitle: What PAYANI is built to do

book.title: Book
book.body: Compare direct and connecting routes, then hand off to the official booking site.

intelligence.title: Intelligence
intelligence.body: Route recommendations that explain themselves with real numbers.

pulse.title: Pulse
pulse.body: Reminders before departure, with honest labels on every train time.

connect.title: Connect
connect.body: Coordinate with fellow travellers safely. No ticket resale, ever.

landing.footer: PAYANI is not affiliated with Indian Railways or IRCTC.

auth.signInIntro: Sign in to continue planning your journeys.
auth.registerIntro: Free, and we only ask for what we need.
auth.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A short sentence works well.

dashboard.intro: Your PAYANI dashboard. Journey tools arrive in the next phase.
dashboard.comingBody: Journey search, route comparison and group planning arrive in Phase 3.
dashboard.dataIntro: Every train time or status you see will carry one of these labels:

admin.usersIntro: Read-only list. Role changes require a Super Administrator.

simulated.label: Simulated
simulated.description: Sandbox or synthetic data. Not a real booking or real railway information.

verified.label: Verified live
verified.description: Confirmed live by an authorised provider.
